purpose: Bounded sanitized provenance summaries for the recovery acceptance checks that previously referenced the claim-bearing acceptance record only (G5-REC-002). Each check points to independently reviewable repository artifacts and required-CI evidence.

webSocketRevoke.summary: At the recovery checkpoint the durable platform-session revoke committed before close propagation; the revoked identity was rejected at handshake with close code 1008 and established connections were closed by the single-process registry. Required CI re-proves revoke-send blocking and expiry fail-closed behavior in the full backend suite on every push.

gp05Smoke.summary: The gp05.v1 four-client real-process smoke ran at the recovery checkpoint and is re-proved by the required CI smoke step on every push.
